premises: Inherited 579, 587 and 595 audits establish exact affine substitution and preservation of every inequality row in its source order.
The maps, source rows and certificates belong to the same immutable initial zero-face system. No changed-state or nonzero-ceiling extrapolation is permitted.
Every map and dot product in the proposed evaluator uses exact rational intermediates. No float matrix product or rounded intermediate stands in for an exact identity.
candidate.fixed_target_associations: All 265967 inequalities, in preserved source572 order; original_row_ids.npy propagates unchanged through 578, 586 and 594. These are the complete existing target sets, not a selected row-family or eligibility scan. Runtime associations would still need explicit frozen verification.
evaluation_sequence: For a new admissible backend u, form the exact composite extension x_star=T578(T586(T594(u))). Preserve u bitwise. Its source572 residual vector gives the exact594 inequality residuals.
Construct w by rounding each of the 68250 eliminated coordinates of x_star once, retaining all backend coordinates unchanged. Apply every existing finite-return rejection rule.
Set v=P586*w and form the separate exact check vector T578(T586(v)). Its source572 residuals give exact586 inequality residuals at the FINAL once-rounded projection v.
Set z=P578*w and form the separate exact check vector T578(z). Its source572 residuals give exact578 inequality residuals at the FINAL once-rounded projection z.
The two separate check vectors are only algebraic evaluation objects. Never substitute either for w, select it as a candidate, or use x_star's residuals to certify the rounded586/578 projections.

Keep equality, bound, sign, stationarity and absolute-gap checks, numeric596 checks, and all source572/570/546/516/full490 checks at their required points. Keep the mandatory interior solve, exact positive eta, finite encoder, model, runtime and physical gates.
candidate.success_test: For every required row and point, a separately frozen independent direct evaluator must obtain the identical exact rational residual, with identical row associations and unchanged rounded candidate bytes. All original admission gates must still pass.
candidate.failure_test: Any missing association/certificate, mismatched residual, changed candidate byte, nonfinite conversion, incomplete coverage or resource-limit failure rejects the evaluator or candidate. No fallback to rounded residuals, tolerances, clipping or solver retries.
